title: The "Common Good" and Cybersecurity
summary: A 20-slide prose-led executive briefing tracing the moral concept of the common good to cyber governance: market failure economics, institutional responses (CVD/CISA, ISACs, NIS2 and the Cyber Solidarity Act, Ostrom, UN norms/Geneva Dialogue/Paris Call), three hard tensions, practitioner implications, and the Singapore AI-trust angle. Built from Reed's Argus-verified brief; deck-light register.
